list.name: agent_id
list.label: Agent
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT ServiceName FROM otel_traces WHERE SpanName = 'agent.session' ORDER BY ServiceName

panels.title: Reliability Score
panels.description: Score = 100 minus penalties: tool failure (-15), retry storm (-10), loop (-25), guardrail (-20), timeout (-30). Clamped 0–100.

targets.rawSql: SELECT greatest(0, 100 - if(countIf(SpanName='tool.call' AND (SpanAttributes['routeiq.tool.success']='false' OR SpanAttributes['claude_code.tool.success']='false')) / nullIf(countIf(SpanName='tool.call'),0) > 0.1, 15, 0) - if(max(toInt32OrZero(SpanAttributes['routeiq.tool.retry_count'])) > 5, 10, 0) - if(countIf(SpanName='tool.call' AND (SpanAttributes['routeiq.loop.detected']='true' OR SpanAttributes['claude_code.tool.loop_detected']='true')) > 0, 25, 0) - if(countIf(SpanName='guardrail.check' AND SpanAttributes['routeiq.guardrail.triggered']='true') > 0, 20, 0) - if(max(if(SpanName='agent.session', Duration/1000000, 0)) > 30000, 30, 0)) AS score FROM otel_traces WHERE match(ServiceName, '${agent_id:regex}') AND Timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL ${time_window}
SELECT count() AS sessions FROM otel_traces WHERE SpanName = 'agent.session' AND match(ServiceName, '${agent_id:regex}') AND Timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL ${time_window}

SELECT avg(session_cost) AS avg_cost FROM (SELECT SpanAttributes['routeiq.session.id'] AS sid, sum(toFloat64OrZero(SpanAttributes['routeiq.cost.usd'])) AS session_cost FROM otel_traces WHERE SpanName = 'llm.call' AND match(ServiceName, '${agent_id:regex}') AND Timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL ${time_window} GROUP BY sid)

SELECT countIf(SpanAttributes['routeiq.tool.success']='false' OR SpanAttributes['claude_code.tool.success']='false') / nullIf(count(),0) AS failure_rate FROM otel_traces WHERE SpanName = 'tool.call' AND match(ServiceName, '${agent_id:regex}') AND Timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL ${time_window}

SELECT countIf(SpanAttributes['routeiq.loop.detected']='true' OR SpanAttributes['claude_code.tool.loop_detected']='true') / nullIf(count(),0) AS loop_rate FROM otel_traces WHERE SpanName = 'tool.call' AND match(ServiceName, '${agent_id:regex}') AND Timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL ${time_window}

SELECT countIf(SpanAttributes['routeiq.guardrail.triggered']='true') / nullIf(count(),0) AS guardrail_rate FROM otel_traces WHERE SpanName = 'guardrail.check' AND match(ServiceName, '${agent_id:regex}') AND Timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL ${time_window}

SELECT toStartOfHour(Timestamp) AS time, quantile(0.95)(Duration / 1000000) AS p95_latency_ms FROM otel_traces WHERE SpanName = 'agent.session' AND match(ServiceName, '${agent_id:regex}') AND Timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL ${time_window} GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT t AS time, avg(session_cost) AS avg_cost_usd FROM (SELECT toStartOfHour(Timestamp) AS t, SpanAttributes['routeiq.session.id'] AS sid, sum(toFloat64OrZero(SpanAttributes['routeiq.cost.usd'])) AS session_cost FROM otel_traces WHERE SpanName = 'llm.call' AND match(ServiceName, '${agent_id:regex}') AND Timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL ${time_window} GROUP BY t, sid) GROUP BY t AS time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Session Drift — Last 10 vs Prior 10
panels.description: Compares avg metrics over the last 10 sessions vs the 10 sessions before that. Delta >20% flagged.

targets.rawSql: WITH ranked AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(SpanAttributes['claude_code.session.id'],''), NULLIF(SpanAttributes['routeiq.session.id'],'')) AS sid, min(Timestamp) AS session_start, max(if(SpanName='agent.session', Duration/1000000, 0)) AS duration_ms, sum(toFloat64OrZero(SpanAttributes['routeiq.cost.usd'])) AS cost, countIf(SpanName='tool.call' AND (SpanAttributes['routeiq.tool.success']='false' OR SpanAttributes['claude_code.tool.success']='false')) / nullIf(countIf(SpanName='tool.call'),0) AS tool_failure_rate, countIf(SpanName='tool.call' AND (SpanAttributes['routeiq.loop.detected']='true' OR SpanAttributes['claude_code.tool.loop_detected']='true')) AS loops, countIf(SpanName='agent.replan') AS replans FROM otel_traces WHERE match(ServiceName, '${agent_id:regex}') GROUP BY sid HAVING sid != '' ORDER BY session_start DESC LIMIT 20), last10 AS (SELECT avg(duration_ms) AS avg_dur, avg(cost) AS avg_cost, avg(tool_failure_rate) AS avg_tfr, avg(loops) AS avg_loops, avg(replans) AS avg_replans FROM ranked LIMIT 10), prior10 AS (SELECT avg(duration_ms) AS avg_dur, avg(cost) AS avg_cost, avg(tool_failure_rate) AS avg_tfr, avg(loops) AS avg_loops, avg(replans) AS avg_replans FROM ranked LIMIT 10 OFFSET 10) SELECT round(last10.avg_dur,0) AS last10_latency_ms, round(prior10.avg_dur,0) AS prior10_latency_ms, round((last10.avg_dur - prior10.avg_dur) / nullIf(prior10.avg_dur,0) * 100, 1) AS latency_delta_pct, round(last10.avg_cost,5) AS last10_cost, round(prior10.avg_cost,5) AS prior10_cost, round((last10.avg_cost - prior10.avg_cost) / nullIf(prior10.avg_cost,0) * 100, 1) AS cost_delta_pct, round(last10.avg_tfr,3) AS last10_tool_fail_rate, round(prior10.avg_tfr,3) AS prior10_tool_fail_rate, round(last10.avg_loops,2) AS last10_loops, round(prior10.avg_loops,2) AS prior10_loops, round(last10.avg_replans,2) AS last10_replans, round(prior10.avg_replans,2) AS prior10_replans FROM last10, prior10

panels.title: All Agents — Click to Drill Into Sessions

targets.rawSql: SELECT ServiceName AS agent, count() AS sessions, round(quantile(0.95)(if(SpanName='agent.session', Duration/1000000, null)),0) AS p95_latency_ms, round(avg(cost),5) AS avg_cost_usd, round(countIf(SpanName='tool.call' AND (SpanAttributes['routeiq.tool.success']='false' OR SpanAttributes['claude_code.tool.success']='false')) / nullIf(countIf(SpanName='tool.call'),0),3) AS tool_failure_rate, round(countIf(SpanName='tool.call' AND (SpanAttributes['routeiq.loop.detected']='true' OR SpanAttributes['claude_code.tool.loop_detected']='true')) / nullIf(countIf(SpanName='tool.call'),0),3) AS loop_rate, round(countIf(SpanName='guardrail.check' AND SpanAttributes['routeiq.guardrail.triggered']='true') / nullIf(countIf(SpanName='guardrail.check'),0),3) AS guardrail_rate FROM (SELECT *, sum(toFloat64OrZero(SpanAttributes['routeiq.cost.usd'])) OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(NULLIF(SpanAttributes['claude_code.session.id'],''), SpanAttributes['routeiq.session.id'])) AS cost FROM otel_traces WHERE Timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL ${time_window}) GROUP BY agent ORDER BY sessions DESC
